frames_manifest._comment: E12 observation set. Real LIBERO frames from the SAME source as bench/fixtures/observation.json (the HuggingFaceVLA/libero dataset through the datasets-server rows API), not re-rendered. They exist because docs/E12_corun/README.md §6.1 requires several materially different observations: with one observation per frame the expert's KV would be identical every frame and a stale-KV bug would be invisible, which would leave the fresh-KV check with no power and every E12 number ungated.

verdict: pipelined / serial = 1.0029 in time, 1.0060 in energy per frame. Neither differs materially, which is what T_pipe = A_iso + B_iso predicts: the schedule does not overlap, so it cannot save either. Energy here is module power x measured frame time; it is not a separate claim about efficiency beyond what those two measurements carry.
derived: energy per frame = module mW x frame ms
energy above idle = (module - idle) mW x frame ms
not_measured: Energy of a pipeline that ACTUALLY overlaps -- none exists on this device, see the report's §1 and §5. This arm measures the schedule as it really runs.

Per-stage energy attribution within a frame: the rails are sampled at 20 Hz and a frame is ~670 ms, so a single frame carries ~13 samples -- enough for a frame mean, not for splitting prefix from expert inside one.
